release.commit_evidence: Deployment identifiers supplied by release owner; actual browser behavior independently observed after frontend reload.

method: Actual MCP Playwright authenticated production UI; native navigation and submitted chat messages, no network stubs, direct API replays, account creation or business record mutations. Native capabilities response read only to compare catalogue/flags.
privacy: No customer/company names, record references/identifiers, financial values, credentials, tokens, private prompts or production screenshots retained.

cases.observed: Visible slash entries exactly match the active-company backend catalogue. All14 supported modules are present for the current native-staff user, plus6 permitted actions. Users entry agrees with the native staff administration menu; edit/delete/PDF entries agree with native capability flags.

limits: Only the current authorized native-staff production account was exercised; non-staff/revoked permission variants are covered by backend tests, not impersonated in this browser run.

latency_method: One observed browser send-to-final-state wall time per prompt, not TTFT, p95 or a controlled performance benchmark.
